description: Prepare Codex94 Git history for Codex sessions.

hooks.command: root="$(unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_SHALLOW_FILE; git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python3 -I "$root/script/codex_prepare.py" --hook
